---
title: "Figure 3 - Univariate antibody features by vaccination group"
output: html_document
---

This notebook compares two-month infant antibody features across the five
maternal vaccination-timing groups. Run `01_load_data.Rmd` first.

## Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggprism)
library(ggpubr)
library(rstatix)
library(tidyr)

helper_dir <- if (dir.exists("../helpful_functions")) {
  "../helpful_functions"
} else {
  "helpful_functions"
}
source(file.path(helper_dir, "data_io.R"))
source(file.path(helper_dir, "analysis_functions.R"))
source(file.path(helper_dir, "plotting_functions.R"))

stopifnot(all(vapply(
  c("infant_data_M2", "infant_meta_M2", "neg_control_threshold"),
  exists,
  logical(1)
)))
```

## 1. Define the displayed features

```{r feature-sets}
spike_features <- c(
  paste0(c("IgG", "IgG1", "IgG2", "IgG3", "IgG4"), "_Spike_WT"),
  paste0(c("FcRn", "FcgR2AR", "FcgR2B", "FcgR3AV", "FcgR3B"), "_Spike_WT")
)
fc_features <- c(
  paste0(c("FcRn", "FcgR2AR", "FcgR2B", "FcgR3AV", "FcgR3B"), "_Spike_WT"),
  paste0(c("FcRn", "FcgR2AR", "FcgR2B", "FcgR3AV", "FcgR3B"), "_RBD_WT")
)
feature_sets <- list(spike = spike_features, fc = fc_features)

all_features <- unique(unlist(feature_sets))
long_data <- infant_data_M2[, all_features, drop = FALSE] %>%
  mutate(vaccine_group = infant_meta_M2$unique_groups) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(all_features),
    names_to = "feature",
    values_to = "value"
  )

feature_tests <- kruskal_by_feature(long_data, group_column = "vaccine_group")
```

## 2. Plot each feature

```{r plot-features}
group_colors <- c("#669ccb", "#004488", "#eccc64", "#92414e", "#e69aa3")

plot_feature <- function(feature) {
  plot_data <- long_data[long_data$feature == feature, , drop = FALSE]

  plot <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(vaccine_group, value, fill = vaccine_group)) +
    geom_violin(adjust = 0.6, draw_quantiles = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = unname(neg_control_threshold[feature]),
      linetype = "dashed"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors) +
    labs(
      x = "Group",
      y = "log10 (MFI)",
      title = format_feature_label(feature)
    ) +
    publication_theme(title_size = 18, axis_title_size = 16, axis_text_size = 12) +
    theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16))

  test <- try(
    dunn_test(plot_data, value ~ vaccine_group, p.adjust.method = "bonferroni"),
    silent = TRUE
  )
  if (!inherits(test, "try-error")) {
    test <- remove_ns(test)
    if (nrow(test) > 0) {
      test <- add_xy_position(test, x = "vaccine_group")
      if (feature %in% c("IgG_Spike_WT", "IgG1_Spike_WT")) {
        test$y.position <- seq(6.2, by = 0.15, length.out = nrow(test))
      }
      plot <- plot + add_pvalue(
        test,
        label = "p.adj.signif",
        xmin = "xmin",
        xmax = "xmax",
        tip.length = c(0, 0)
      )
    }
  }
  plot
}

feature_plots <- setNames(lapply(all_features, plot_feature), all_features)
figure_3_spike <- ggarrange(
  plotlist = feature_plots[spike_features],
  nrow = 2,
  ncol = 5
)
figure_3_fc <- ggarrange(
  plotlist = feature_plots[fc_features],
  nrow = 2,
  ncol = 5
)
```

## 3. Save panels

```{r save-figures}
ggsave(
  output_path("Figure_3", "Figure_3_univariate_Spike.png"),
  figure_3_spike,
  width = 12,
  height = 7,
  units = "in"
)
ggsave(
  output_path("Figure_3", "Figure_3_univariate_Fc.png"),
  figure_3_fc,
  width = 12,
  height = 7,
  units = "in"
)
```
